After breakfast, you transfer to the airport for your flight to Cartagena. Your guide meets you on arrival and takes you on a city tour.

You start by passing through the residential neighbourhoods of Bocagrande, Castillogrande and Manga. Then you go up La Popa, a 150 m hill with panoramic views over Cartagena and its harbour.

At the top are the 17th-century Santa Cruz Monastery and a revered image of Our Lady of Candelaria.

Next is the fortress of San Felipe de Barajas. Built to defend Cartagena against attacks by sea and land, it is considered the largest fortress the Spanish built in the Americas. Construction lasted from 1639 to 1762.

Cartagena is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Within the walls of the historic centre are squares, churches, colonial-era houses and narrow streets.

On the walk, you can see the Clock Gate, Plaza de los Coches, Plaza de San Pedro, the Palace of the Inquisition, the 16th-century cathedral, Plaza de Santo Domingo and the Heredia Theatre.

The old city’s neighbourhoods each have their own character. In San Diego, the Santa Clara hotel occupies the former convent of Saint Clare, and the Santa Catalina fort is also in the neighbourhood. Getsemaní was once home to enslaved people. Today it has a convention centre and popular nightlife venues.

Below the walls of old Cartagena is the Las Bóvedas market. Shops occupy former prison cells and sell hammocks, woven bags and other souvenirs.

After the tour, you check in at your hotel.

After breakfast, you set out on a sightseeing transfer to the islands.

First, you transfer to Marina Santa Cruz. You board a speedboat at the Pegasos pier.

The route crosses the bays of Cartagena and Bocachica, with views of the San Fernando and San José forts from the water. The boat passes San Fernando in Bocachica and continues towards Barú and the Rosario Islands.

A cocktail welcomes you to the island before you spend time at the beach.

The Rosario Islands are home to a national underwater park covering about 19,500 hectares. The coastal waters are known for corals, sponges, crustaceans, molluscs and many tropical fish.

Optional activities include diving, taking a walk, kayaking through the mangroves, cycling, booking a massage or visiting the Encantada Lagoon.

Afterwards, you transfer to your hotel on the island.
